## CONCIERGE OUTPUT
Try searching for just the first word of the company name or the full legal business name. You can also select 'Self-employed' or 'N/A' if you can't find your employer. If that still doesn't work, tap the message icon in the top right corner of the app, then tap 'Send us a message' and mention the specific employers.
